title: 第6587章 先知族降临第6586章 你以后要是再敢吹牛信不信我直接踢死你
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: “这些石头我全部都要了。”
没有所谓的讨价还价，苏辰直接全部购买下来。
别人不认识混沌石，他怎么可能不认识。
唯有混沌界才拥有的混沌石，却会出现在小世界。
苏辰很清楚混沌石的价值，要比任何东西都要珍贵。
在混沌界，混沌石也许不算什么，但放在任何一个小世界，都是可遇而不可求的东西。
大概只有十数枚混沌石，但对于苏辰来说，已经足够了。
“小兄弟还需要这种石头吗？”
“你还有？”
“当然，你想要多少。”
“你有多少。”
强忍着心里的无尽惊喜，在苏辰看来，不管对方手里有多少的混沌石，他都会毫不犹豫的全部买下来。
有多少，买多少。
照单全收。
真是好买卖。
地摊老板笑着说道：“给我三天时间，我帮你多搞一些这种石头。”
“好，我三天来找你。”
看着转身离去的身影，地摊老板笑着说道：“这种破石头，竟然能卖出价格，终于找到个大冤种，这次算是赚大了。”
离开后的苏辰，则是直接召唤出豨封，说道：“跟着他，记住，不要打草惊蛇。”
豨封当然明白老大的意思，则是小心翼翼的跟着地摊老板。
肯定是要购买混沌石，但前提是，他必须知道地摊老板到底是从哪里得到的这些混沌石，必须找到源头。
回到客栈，苏辰第一时间取出混沌石，体内开始运转混沌吞噬诀，头顶上空凝聚出吞噬血轮，想要尝试是否能够吞噬混沌石内的混沌力量。
苏辰的意思很简单。
就是看看，自己是否能够借助混沌石内的混沌力量，来相助自己顺利的突破自身极限。
结果却是，无论苏辰如何调动体内的吞噬力量，都无法顺利炼化混沌石内的力量，甚至都无法摄取出来。
要真是如此的话，自己就算是得到混沌石又能怎样。
立刻进入混沌吞噬塔。
看到塔灵的瞬间，苏辰开门见山的说道：“塔灵，我已经顺利得到混沌石，你是否愿意帮我摄取和炼化。”
塔灵却是摇摇头，说道：“主人，我明白你的意思，但我还告诉你的是，就算是我帮你摄取出混沌力量也没有用。”
“为何？”
“就算是你拥有着混沌吞噬诀，也无法强行炼化和融合混沌力量，要是非要如此做，不仅对你没有任何的好处，甚至还会适得其反，得不偿失的事情。”
原本还想着，看看是否能够借助塔灵的相助，来炼化和融合混沌石内的混沌力量。
现在看来，完全是自己想多了。
“主人，你得到了混沌石？”

;;
"I want all these stones."
There was no so-called bargaining, Su Chen bought them all directly.
Others don't know Chaos Stone, how could he not know it.
The Chaos Stone, which is only available in the Chaos World, appears in the Small World.
Su Chen knew very well that the value of the Chaos Stone was more precious than anything else.
In the world of chaos, Chaos Stone may not be a big deal, but in any small world, it is something that can be encountered but cannot be sought.
There were only about a dozen Chaos Stones, but for Su Chen, it was enough.
"Little brother, do you still need this kind of stone?"
"You still have it?"
"Of course, as much as you want."
"How many do you have?"
Holding back the endless surprise in his heart, Su Chen thought that no matter how many Chaos Stones the other party had in his hand, he would buy them all without hesitation.
Buy as much as you have.
Take all orders as ordered.
What a good deal.
The stall owner smiled and said, "Give me three days and I will help you get more of these stones."
"Okay, I'll come find you in three days."
Looking at the figure turning away, the stall owner said with a smile: "This kind of broken stone can be sold at a high price. I finally found a big enemy. This time I made a big profit."
After leaving, Su Chen directly summoned Xi Feng and said, "Follow him. Remember, don't alert the enemy."
"Yes."
Of course Xi Feng understood what the boss meant, so he followed the stall owner cautiously.
He must buy Chaos Stones, but the prerequisite is that he must know where the stall owner got these Chaos Stones from, and he must find the source.
Back at the inn, Su Chen immediately took out the Chaos Stone and began to run the Chaos Devouring Technique in his body. The Devouring Blood Wheel condensed above his head, trying to see if he could swallow the chaotic power in the Chaos Stone.
Su Chen's meaning is very simple.
Just to see if I can use the power of chaos in the Chaos Stone to help me successfully break through my own limits.
The result was that no matter how Su Chen mobilized the devouring power in his body, he could not successfully refine the power in the Chaos Stone, or even absorb it.
If that were the case, what would he do even if he got the Chaos Stone?
Enter the Chaos Devouring Tower immediately.
The moment he saw the Ta Ling, Su Chen said straight to the point: "Ta Ling, I have successfully obtained the Chaos Stone. Are you willing to help me absorb and refine it?"
The tower spirit shook his head and said: "Master, I understand what you mean, but what I also tell you is that even if I help you absorb the power of chaos, it will be useless."
"Why?"
"Even if you possess the Chaos Devouring Technique, you cannot forcibly refine and fuse the power of chaos. If you have to do this, not only will it not be of any benefit to you, it will even be counterproductive, and the gain will outweigh the loss."
I originally thought to see if I could use the help of the tower spirit to refine and integrate the chaotic power in the chaos stone.
Now it seems that I am completely overthinking it.
"Master, did you get the Chaos Stone?"
